propositions: An offline rewrite engine must collapse below-horizon derived commits and trees into parentless SNAPSHOT checkpoints using core-git fast-import on a disposable shadow clone without mutating production.

The authorship ledger must be reconciled by re-resolving each invariant position to its new commit SHA and re-anchoring identity.enforce_since to the new baseline so verify_authorship_at_commit evaluates consistently.
The engine must refuse execution on non-shadow targets, configured live tracker paths, or clones with push-capable remotes to prevent accidental production mutation.
Above-horizon history and all observable ticket state must be bit-identical in reduced form before and after the rewrite operation.
The CLI command rebar reclaim-collapse must be registered with a parser under _cli/_parsers/core/reclaim.py with optional dry-run and source/ref arguments.
